items.why: Guess captures holding things in but not the paradox about writing as release.
Guess matches the son courting her waterfront land.
Quiet letters from Theodore matches the contrast being drawn.
Theodore writing notes to her matches the narration.
Narration is about DNA sites and emails to a customer service rep, not Harry finding an address.
Guess says she received the rude email, but she wrote it.
Guess is vague about whose words and misses that she types them.
He still loves her matches Theodore loving her anyway.
